create.name: Paul Selig
create.bio:
Paul Selig is a channel and author whose books record the teachings of a group of non-physical voices he simply calls the Guides. Born in New York City and educated at Yale, where he took a master's degree, an experience in 1987 opened him to clairvoyant perception. To make sense of it he trained in a form of energy work and began to hear information for clients, and for many years he combined that with a long academic career, teaching at New York University and directing the creative writing MFA at Goddard College.

Since I Am the Word appeared in 2010 he has published a long series of channelled books, including The Book of Mastery, the Beyond the Known trilogy and, more recently, The Upper Room. Their recurring theme is the realisation of a divine or higher self in ordinary life, and the readings often pause for spoken affirmations the reader is invited to repeat. He has taught workshops at Omega, Kripalu and Esalen, now lives on Maui, and teaches largely through weekly livestreams, online intensives and residential retreats in several countries. He also gives private readings over Zoom.

books.title: I Am the Word: A Guide to the Consciousness of Man's Self in a Transitioning Time
books.author: Paul Selig
books.description: His first channelled book, taken down over a series of sessions with the Guides. It lays out the core idea of the later books: that each person can come to know and speak from their divine self.

books.title: Beyond the Known: Realization
books.author: Paul Selig
books.description: The first volume of a trilogy about stepping past fixed ideas of who we are and what the world is, so that a wider knowing can come through.

books.title: Alchemy: A Channeled Text
books.author: Paul Selig
books.description: The second Beyond the Known book, on how ordinary experience is changed when it is met from a higher state of awareness.

books.title: The Kingdom: A Channeled Text
books.author: Paul Selig
books.description: The closing volume of the trilogy, describing the world seen through realised awareness as the 'kingdom' already present.

books.title: A World Made New: A Channeled Text
books.author: Paul Selig
books.description: Part of the Manifestation trilogy, looking at how collective change and personal awakening feed each other in a time of upheaval.

books.title: Divine Union: The Essential Path to Oneness
books.author: Paul Selig
books.description: A channelled text on the experience of oneness with the divine and with others, and on what gets in its way.

books.title: The Upper Room: Becoming the Divine Self
books.author: Paul Selig
books.description: His latest book, built on the image of an 'upper room' of consciousness from which a person can live as their divine self.

courses.title: Shifting Reality: A Weeklong Retreat in Costa Rica
courses.description: A seven-day channelled retreat at a beach retreat centre in Nosara, Costa Rica, working directly with Paul and the Guides on their programme for personal growth.

courses.title: Paul Selig: A Retreat at Crystalbrook Byron, Byron Bay Australia
courses.description: His first retreat in Australia: six days of channelled teaching at a rainforest resort near the ocean in Byron Bay. Meals and five nights' lodging are included.

courses.title: Paul Selig: A Retreat at Broughton Sanctuary, Yorkshire England
courses.description: A six-day channelled retreat on a large country estate in Yorkshire, about an hour north of Manchester.

courses.title: Paul Selig: A Retreat in Northern Italy 2027
courses.description: Six days with Paul and the Guides at a mountainside retreat centre north of Milan, with students from many countries.

courses.title: Private Readings with Paul Selig
courses.description: One-to-one readings over Zoom in which Paul tunes in to the client and the people in their life. Regular readings have a long waiting list; shorter-notice priority readings cost more.
courses.price: $400 for 30 minutes (regular); priority $400 for 15 minutes or $650 for 30 minutes
